question: What do seniors need to do before graduation?
answer:
Here are the main tasks and requirements for Vista Ridge seniors in the Class of 2027 before graduation, based on the information provided:

**Required Tasks:**
- **Order Cap and Gown:** Seniors must order the Cap, Gown & Tassel Unit from Herff Jones. This is required for graduation. Order information and packets will be distributed at a senior meeting, and more details are available on the Herff Jones website.
- **Fill out the FAFSA:** Completing the FAFSA ([FAFSA website](https://studentaid.gov/)) is a high school graduation requirement. The application opens October 1st. The priority deadline for most Texas universities is January 15th, but it’s recommended to check specific university deadlines to maximize financial aid opportunities.

**Important Dates & Activities:**
- **Senior Panoramic Picture:** Scheduled for Wednesday, March 24th during Ranger Time.
- **Cap & Gown Pickup:** Will occur during lunches. All obligations and hours must be cleared before pickup.
- **Senior SAIL:** A special event for seniors to relax and enjoy time with classmates in the courtyard, including lunch and activities.
- **Graduation Practice & Clap Out:** Graduation practice will be held and immediately followed by a celebratory clap out.
- **Elementary Graduation Walks:** Graduates can visit their former LISD elementary schools in cap and gown (check [this link](https://news.leanderisd.org/class-of-2026-senior-walks-schedule-announced/) for details). If your elementary school is not part of LISD, contact that school directly.
- **Name Pronunciation Form:** In May, seniors will complete a form to ensure their names are pronounced correctly at commencement.
- **Senior Awards Ceremony:** This is by invitation only for qualifying students.
- **Baccalaureate:** A morning event to celebrate graduating seniors.
- **Prom, Senior Scramble, Project Graduation:** Special senior events with more details to come. [Project Graduation Information](https://sites.google.com/view/vistaridgeprojectgrad/home)

**Other Things To Do:**
- **Google Account Transition:** After graduation (usually in July), your school Google account will transition to an alumni account and remain active for one year. Download any files you wish to keep, as you will lose the ability to create new documents after graduation.
- **Clear All Obligations:** Any outstanding obligations or required service hours must be completed and cleared to participate in graduation activities and to collect your cap and gown.

If you have specific questions or need to check your personal status, it’s best to contact your counselor or the front office. You can also visit the [Seniors 2027 page](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/seniors-2027#h.8303diwz6ah) for more details.

Good luck with your senior year, Ranger! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.

question: What is the student check-out policy?
answer:
Here is an overview of the current (2026-2027 school year) student check-out policy at Vista Ridge High School:

- **Checking Out Early:**  
  - Parents/guardians must come to the office in person, with a photo ID, to check their student out.
  - Phone calls for leaving early are **not accepted**.
  - Students **must sign in/out** at the Attendance Window when leaving or returning to campus.
  - You are asked to arrive at least 20 minutes **before** you need your student to be released due to high request volume.
  - **In-person early check-outs after 2:45 pm will not be granted.** After 2:45 pm, students must wait for normal dismissal.
  - For early release days, the cut-off for pick up is 11:45 am.

- **Excusing the Absence:**
  - After your student’s absence, you must provide a note or email documenting the reason for the absence for it to be excused.
  - Notes/emails should include the student’s full legal name, ID number, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal.
  - Emails sent before 10:30 AM can be used for check-outs at any time later in the day.

- **Important Notes:**  
  - If checking out during lunch or an athletic period, there may be a longer wait or difficulty locating the student.
  - Documentation for absences is important to avoid truancy issues.

For detailed steps and the most current procedures, please refer to the official document: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out).

If you have individual questions, the Attendance Office can assist you. Go Rangers!

question: What clubs and organizations are offered?
answer:
Vista Ridge High School offers a variety of clubs and organizations for students to get involved in. Here are a few of the clubs listed in the current context:

- **Meetings:** After school (days to be announced)

- **Sponsor:** Vanessa Ramirez (vanessa.ramirez@leanderisd.org)
- **Meetings:** B-Day Ranger Times in room 2623

- **Purpose:** Community service, character building, and leadership development through hands-on experience.
- **Sponsor:** Caitlyn Goodfellow (caitlyn.goodfellow@leanderisd.org)
- **Meetings:** Tuesdays in the Lecture Hall or Library

- **Eligibility:** Students enrolled in specific Biomed CTE courses (PBS, HBS, MI, A&P, Medical Terms, Med Micro, SRD)

- **Meetings:** 3rd week of the month (General Meeting), 4th week (Competition Meeting), both on Wednesdays during Ranger Time in room 1802
